## Name & positioning
- Product name: LandingCritic
- One-line value: LandingCritic gives your landing page a blunt 5-point critique — value prop, CTA, target user, proof, and pricing — with a score and the one fix to do first.
- Domain: https://landing-critic.lxsaihub.com/

## FAQ
Q1. What is LandingCritic?
A1. LandingCritic is a tool that gives your landing page a 5-point critique with a score and the top fix to make.
Q2. What five points does it check?
A2. Value prop, CTA, target user, proof, and pricing.
Q3. Does it give a score?
A3. Yes. It scores the page out of 5 across the checklist.
Q4. What is the priority fix?
A4. It names the single highest-priority fix to do first.
Q5. Who should use it?
A5. Indie founders shipping without a copywriter who want an honest page critique.
Q6. Is the output copy-ready?
A6. The critique is copy-ready guidance you apply to your own page.
